description: Secretariate of the Governor - Eastern Province - Coastal Walkway of the Inner Harbour Road under the Jurisdiction of Trincomalee Municipal Council Changed as " Ocean Breeze Walkway with Effect from 11.09.2024"
reasoning: This gazette primarily deals with land and property-related matters, specifically the reclassification and modification of a coastal walkway under the jurisdiction of the Trincomalee Municipal Council. It details changes to the physical characteristics of the land (width, naming, installations like seats and lights, signage) and declares new land use regulations (prohibition of trade activities). The involvement of the Provincial Governor and Council is in their capacity as the administrative authority for this local land matter, not for announcing government personnel or structural changes, making it a Land Gazette.
